tokoh_utama: A 24-year-old Indonesian man with short messy black hair, wearing a dark navy blue polo shirt with an office ID card lanyard, pale skin, exhausted expression.

part.caption: Jangan pernah naik lift sendirian kalau sudah lewat jam satu malam... ini alasannya.

adegan.narasi: Jam setengah dua malam, aku baru pulang lembur dengan badan sangat capek.
adegan.gambar: A tired young Indonesian man standing in a dim, deserted apartment lobby holding a backpack, leaning against the wall near an old elevator.

adegan.narasi: Lift apartemen tua ini selalu sepi dan lampu indikatornya sering berkedip.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of an vintage metal elevator panel in a dark hallway, yellow floor display flickering faintly with shadows overhead.

adegan.narasi: Aku masuk ke dalam lift, memencet tombol angka tujuh seperti biasa.
adegan.gambar: Inside the elevator, the young man pushes button number 7 on the metallic elevator control panel.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba lift bergetar hebat dan terus bergerak naik melampaui lantai sepuluh.
adegan.gambar: The elevator interior shaking violently, the young man holding onto the metal handrail in panic, overhead light flickering.

adegan.narasi: Layar indikator digital mendadak mati, berganti tulisan aneh bertuliskan angka nol.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the elevator digital screen showing a distorted glitched red digit zero instead of floor numbers.

adegan.narasi: Suara berdenging keras terdengar, lalu lift berhenti mendadak di lantai tak dikenal.
adegan.gambar: The young man covering his ears in discomfort inside the cramped steel elevator cabin, looking up in fear.

adegan.narasi: Pintu lift terbuka pelan, memperlihatkan lorong gelap gulita berbau bunga melati busuk.
adegan.gambar: Elevator doors sliding open to reveal an unlit, damp corridor covered in heavy shadows and thick low-hanging grey mist.

adegan.narasi: Di ujung lorong gelap, berdiri sosok tinggi kurus dengan posisi tubuh bungkuk.
adegan.gambar: A tall, unnaturally thin shadowy figure standing hunched at the end of the dark corridor, lit only by dim elevator light.

adegan.narasi: Sosok itu perlahan menoleh, memperlihatkan wajah pucat tanpa mata dengan senyum lebar.
adegan.gambar: Terrifying close-up of a pale ghastly face with pitch-black empty eye sockets and a bizarrely wide, unnatural grin.

adegan.narasi: Tangannya yang sangat panjang dan pucat tiba-tiba menahan pintu lift yang terbuka.
adegan.gambar: Extremely long, pale, bony fingers grasping the edge of the elevator door frame, preventing it from closing.

adegan.narasi: Dia melangkah masuk satu titik, lalu berbisik pelan, "Lantai ini belum selesai."
adegan.gambar: The creepy pale creature stepping closer into the lift light, its mouth open wide as it leans forward.

adegan.narasi: Wajahnya yang mengerikan mendekat cepat persis di depan mataku tanpa bersuara sama sekali.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up jumpscare of the faceless pale creature staring directly at the viewer with an uncanny stretched smile.

part.caption: Mata bolong itu melihat ke arahku dari balik pintu kamar...

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan malam itu, aku panik setengah mati memencet tombol tutup berkali-kali.
adegan.gambar: The young man aggressively mashing the elevator door close button with a sweaty, trembling hand.

adegan.narasi: Sosok mengerikan itu menahan pintu sambil berbisik, "Kenapa mau buru-buru pulang?"
adegan.gambar: The tall pale entity leaning into the elevator doorway, its wide empty face grinning unnaturally right in front of the young man.

adegan.narasi: Pintu lift akhirnya tertutup rapat setelah aku memukul tombol lantai satu panik.
adegan.gambar: The elevator metal doors slamming shut, blocking out the dark hallway as the young man slides down against the lift wall.

adegan.narasi: Lift mendadak meluncur turun sangat cepat sampai membuat kepalaku terasa begitu pusing.
adegan.gambar: Inside the falling elevator, motion blur effect showing lights streaking as the young man holds his head in fear.

adegan.narasi: Lampu lift berkedip-kedip cepat sebelum akhirnya lift berhenti dengan hantaman keras.
adegan.gambar: The elevator landing hard, dust falling from the ceiling, overhead panel flickering dimly in complete chaos.

adegan.narasi: Pintu terbuka lagi, memperlihatkan lorong yang persis seperti lantai tujuh tempat kosku.
adegan.gambar: Elevator doors open to reveal an apartment corridor that looks familiar, with room doors and dim orange hallway lamps.

adegan.narasi: Aku keluar ragu-ragu dan berjalan mendekati pintu kamarku nomor tujuh ratus empat.
adegan.gambar: The young man walking cautiously down the quiet corridor toward door room 704.

adegan.narasi: Pintu kamar sedikit terbuka, memperlihatkan cahaya lampu teras yang kedap-kedip pelan.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of wooden door room 704 slightly ajar, warm dim light flickering from inside the room.

adegan.narasi: Aku mengintip lewat celah pintu dan melihat seseorang sedang duduk di tempat tidurku.
adegan.gambar: POV peeking through the cracked door frame, showing a figure seated on the mattress in a dark bedroom.

adegan.narasi: Orang itu memakai baju yang sama persis seperti baju yang sedang aku pakai.
adegan.gambar: Inside the room, the seated figure wears the exact same navy blue polo shirt and ID lanyard as the main character.

adegan.narasi: Perlahan sosok yang mirip denganku itu memutar lehernya ke belakang seratus delapan puluh derajat.
adegan.gambar: Shocking view of the figure's head rotating unnaturally backward 180 degrees to face the door.

adegan.narasi: Matanya bolong menghitam dan dia tersenyum lebar sambil membisikkan namaku dari jauh.
adegan.gambar: Close-up horrifying face of the doppelganger with hollow black eye holes grinning malevolently right at the camera.

part.caption: Coba cek foto HP-mu sekarang... siapa tahu ada yang memotretmu dari belakang.

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan... Sosok yang mirip denganku itu mendadak merangkak cepat ke arah pintu.
adegan.gambar: The creepy double crawling rapidly on all fours toward the doorway with limbs bent weirdly.

adegan.narasi: Aku menjerit ketakutan, berlari kencang kembali ke dalam lift dan memencet tombol.
adegan.gambar: The young man sprinting in sheer panic back down the hallway toward the illuminated elevator.

adegan.narasi: Pintu lift tertutup tepat saat tangan pucatnya hampir menyambar kakiku dari luar.
adegan.gambar: Pale twisted fingers reaching into the narrowing gap of the sliding elevator doors just as they snap shut.

adegan.narasi: Lift bergerak cepat dan akhirnya pintu terbuka di lantai dasar yang terang benderang.
adegan.gambar: Elevator doors open to a brightly lit, normal lobby floor with clean tiles and bright overhead lights.

adegan.narasi: Satpam apartemen menatapku bingung saat aku berlari kencang menuju tangga darurat.
adegan.gambar: A uniformed security guard standing near desk looking startled as the main character rushes past him.

adegan.narasi: Sampai di kamar asliku, aku langsung mengunci pintu rapat-rapat sambil napas terengah-engah.
adegan.gambar: The young man pressing his back against his locked room door, sweating heavily, gasping for air.

adegan.narasi: Suara kipas angin kamar dan bunyi motor di luar membuatku merasa sedikit tenang.
adegan.gambar: Interior of a small cozy Indonesian rental room, a standing fan spinning slowly near a desk.

adegan.narasi: HP di genggamanku mendadak bergetar kuat menandakan ada satu pesan gambar masuk.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of a smartphone screen lighting up in the dark room with a notification box: '1 New Image Received'.

adegan.narasi: Aku membuka pesan dari nomor tak dikenal itu dengan tangan yang sangat gemetaran.
adegan.gambar: The young man's trembling thumb tapping the phone screen in suspense.

adegan.narasi: Foto itu memperlihatkan kamarku dari sudut belakang, diambil tepat detik ini juga.
adegan.gambar: On the phone screen, a dark photo shows the main character from behind, holding his phone in his room.

adegan.narasi: Di foto tersebut, tampak sosok tanpa mata berdiri tepat di belakang punggungku sekarang.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the phone screen showing the terrifying empty-eyed tall entity looming right behind his shoulder in the photo.

adegan.narasi: Hembusan napas dingin terasa di leherku dan suara itu berbisik, "Sudah sampai."
adegan.gambar: Terrifying close-up of the ghastly pale entity standing directly behind the protagonist's shoulder, whispering into his ear.

tema: lift apartemen yang berhenti di lantai yang tidak ada
